title: Pentaryn Resume
description: Each player logs back in on the map they last had open, at the same spot and zoom, as long as the GM has not moved the table to a new active scene since. Survives the 03:00 nightly restart. Exposes game.pentaryn.resume.

afterSync: First install: restart Foundry (module.json is read at startup), enable 'Pentaryn Resume', then reload.
